```{r}
storms <- read_csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv")
```
```{r}
#wrangling for damage visualizations

si2num <- function(storms)
{
  conv <- paste0("e", c(seq(-24 ,-3, by=3), -2, -1, seq(3, 24, by=3),3))
  names(conv) <- c("y","z","a","f","p","n","µ","m","c","d","K","M","G","T","P","E","Z","Y","k")
  
  xout <- str_replace_all(storms, conv)
  xout <- as.numeric(xout)
  
  return(xout)
}

damages <- storms |>
  group_by(EVENT_TYPE, STATE, YEAR) |>
  summarize(
    total_property = sum(DAMAGE_PROPERTY),
    total_crops = sum(DAMAGE_CROPS),
    per_month_property = total_property/12,
    per_month_crops = total_crops/12
  )
```
